text:
The design misses only on noise, by about 15% (287 vs 250 fA/√Hz). Bandwidth and power still have margin.

**Noise.** The sensitivities point to input capacitance as the main noise source. Higher gm/Id on M1 widens it, which raises Cin and so the noise term that grows with Cin and frequency.

**Changes to search.**
- Lower gm/Id on M1 and allow a shorter L1.
- Allow a larger Rf, which lowers its own thermal noise.
- Allow more M1 current; power is at 38.8 of 47 µW.

The topology is sound, so I'll refine rather than edit.
